title: Signal envelope
description: A signal as it travels on the bus: framework-set envelope plus emitter-set type and payload. SPEC §2.

contractVersion.description: Signal Contract version tag, framework-stamped (never emitter-set). Pinned to the single version this runtime speaks; cross-version negotiation is a v2 concern. SPEC §2.

id.description: Unique per emission. Agent emissions get a deterministic id derived from (runId, events-line index), so a replayed events line yields the same id and the delivery ledger routes it at most once.

provenance.description: Ordered causality chain: the (source, signal) pairs that led to this emission, oldest first. Empty for monitor-emitted signals. SPEC §7.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON, validated against the emitter's declared JSON Schema.

work.description: Optional logical work identity for duplicate suppression, scoped per target agent by the framework (SPEC §6.6). The same (agent, key, attempt) runs at most once within the replay-retention window; attempt (default 1) expresses a deliberate retry; a new revision of the work is a new key.
